title.yo: Pínpín sí ẹgbẹ́ tí ó dọ́gba

objectives.en: Share any number up to forty eight into two, three, four, five or six equal groups.
objectives.yo: Pín nọ́ńbà èyíkéyìí dé forty eight sí ẹgbẹ́ dọ́gba two, three, four, five tàbí six.
objectives.pcm: Share any number reach forty eight into two, three, four, five or six equal group.

objectives.en: Use a times fact backwards to find the missing number.
objectives.yo: Lo times fact padà sẹ́yìn láti rí nọ́ńbà tí ó sọnù.
objectives.pcm: Use times fact backwards to find the number wey miss.

curriculum.objective: divide numbers up to 48 by 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 with no remainder; find factors and multiples; find a missing factor

say.en: You have twenty four oranges and six friends. Every friend gets the same number. Today we share.
say.pcm: You get twenty four orange and six padi. Share am equal. Today we go share.
say.yo: O ní ọ̀sàn twenty four àti ọ̀rẹ́ six. Pín wọn dọ́gba. Lónìí a ó pín.

say.en: Today you will share numbers into equal groups by yourself.
say.pcm: Today you go fit share numbers into equal groups.
say.yo: Lónìí ìwọ yóò pín nọ́ńbà sí ẹgbẹ́ dọ́gba.

say.en: Do you remember your sixes? Count in sixes to twenty four.
say.pcm: You remember your sixes? Count in sixes reach twenty four.
say.yo: Ṣé o rántí sixes rẹ? Kà ní sixes dé twenty four.

say.en: Sharing equally is dividing. Twenty four oranges go to six friends, four each. Six times four is twenty-four.
say.pcm: To share equal equal na dividing. Twenty four orange go six padi, four each. Six times four na twenty-four.
say.yo: Pínpín dọ́gba ni dividing. A pín ọ̀sàn twenty four sí ọ̀rẹ́ six, four fún ẹnìkọ̀ọ̀kan. Six times four jẹ́ twenty-four.

say.en: Now together. Fifteen mangoes, five children, the same number each. Five times what makes fifteen?
say.pcm: Make we share together. Fifteen mango, five pikin, equal each. Five times wetin go give fifteen?
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká pín papọ̀. Mángòrò fifteen, ọmọ five, dọ́gba fún gbogbo wọn. Five times kí ni ó jẹ́ fifteen?

say.en: Your turn. Thirty six sweets, four children, equal each. How many sweets does one child get?
say.pcm: Na your turn. Thirty six sweet, four pikin, equal each. How many sweet one pikin go collect?
say.yo: Ìwọ ná. Sweets thirty six, ọmọ four, dọ́gba fún gbogbo wọn. Sweets mélòó ni ọmọ kan gbà?

say.en: If your answer was not nine, use four times nine. Four times nine is thirty-six. Each group gets nine.
say.pcm: Make we fix am together. Use four times nine: thirty-six. So each one get nine.
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká tún ṣe é papọ̀. Lo four times nine: thirty-six. Nítorí náà ẹnìkọ̀ọ̀kan gba nine.

say.en: Let us see what you remember. Forty two books are shared among six pupils. How many does each get?
say.pcm: Make we see wetin you remember. Forty two book share for six pupil. How many each one go get?
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká wo ohun tí o rántí. Ìwé forty two fún akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ six. Mélòó ni ẹnìkọ̀ọ̀kan gbà?

say.en: Well done. Sharing turns times work backwards. Tomorrow we share. Soon we find factors.
say.pcm: You do well. Sharing turns times work backwards. Tomorrow we share again, then find factors and multiples.
say.yo: O ṣe dáadáa. Pínpín yí times sí ẹ̀yìn. Lọ́la a ó tún pín, a ó sì wá factors àti multiples.
